usecase.name: Start Match
usecase.trigger: Player selects "Battle" from the Mythic Forge
usecase.precondition: Player has a faction selected and a valid 9-10 card deck

mainflow.step: System displays Versus Intro scene: both faction sigils with taglines (~3s, skippable)
System reveals Match Opening scene: overhead chromosome arena, both lanes, shimmering neutral center node
System deals 5 cards to player's hand; Resonance set to starting value
Match timer starts (3:00)

usecase.postcondition: Match is live; both players can deploy

usecase.name: Deploy Card
usecase.trigger: Player drags a card from hand onto a lane
usecase.precondition: Player has enough Resonance; target is a valid lane (not the Center Node)

mainflow.step: System burns the card visual on release
System tears a veil-portal in the faction's neon color at the drop point
Unit actor spawns through the portal within 1s; Player[1].Card[n] data binds to the actor
Resonance is deducted; next card drawn to hand

usecase.postcondition: Unit is live on the lane following its route

usecase.name: Inspect Card
usecase.trigger: Player hovers over a card in hand

mainflow.step: System displays card detail: cost, HP, DMG, ability text

usecase.postcondition: Player has full card information; no game state changes

usecase.name: Conversion Flip
usecase.trigger: A unit enters Drift (below 20% HP) and a conversion effect applies
usecase.precondition: Target is convertible (not Ascended; not protected by Anchor-Line Enforcer)

mainflow.step: System strikes the tuning-fork audio cue; unit shudders/vibrates
Unit's aura drains from old faction color downward; new faction color rises from the ground
Unit fights for the converter for 15s; faint after-image in old color fades over the duration
On expiry, the converted unit is removed from the field

usecase.postcondition: Temporary allegiance flip resolved; extension cap 9s total enforced

usecase.name: Ascend Unit
usecase.trigger: A unit survives 30s on the field

mainflow.step: System fires a vertical pillar of faction-neon light from the unit
A billboarded eye-sigil appears above the unit (always camera-facing)
Rising chime audio; unit gains +20% HP and +15% damage once

usecase.postcondition: Unit is Ascended; cannot be converted thereafter

usecase.name: Deploy Hero
usecase.trigger: Player drags the hero card onto a lane

mainflow.step: System washes the field to black-and-white (~1.5-2s); all audio cuts to silence for half a beat
Short cutscene: hero revealed, hero's faction neon the only color in frame
Hero lands with deep impact audio; Center Node pulses in hero's faction color
Color and battle resume

usecase.postcondition: Hero is live on the lane

usecase.name: Resolve Victory
usecase.trigger: Enemy anchor destroyed (or timer expires with player ahead)

mainflow.step: Loser's faction color drains from the arena
Winner's faction color floods the arena; graphics shift to winner's field representation
Enemy anchor shatters (not building-collapse)
Winner's faction motif swells in audio

usecase.name: Resolve Defeat
usecase.trigger: Player's anchor destroyed (or timer expires behind)

mainflow.step: Same choreography as UC-07 from the losing side: player color drains, enemy floods, player anchor shatters

usecase.name: Contest Center Node
usecase.trigger: Units from one faction hold the Center Node uncontested

mainflow.step: Node's glow/shimmer transitions to the holder's faction neon color
Node bonus (TBD) applies while held

usecase.postcondition: Node control readable at a glance

usecase.name: Open Scroll
usecase.trigger: Player selects a scroll in the Mythic Forge

mainflow.step: Scroll floats into the forge and unfurls mid-air
Forge fire flares; flame color reveals rarity (dim blue-gray common / bright blue rare / purple epic / white-gold legendary)
Card materializes from the flame, back-first, then flips to reveal the unit
New unit: anvil-strike flash and ring. Duplicate: card melts into embers flowing to the owned card (see UC-11)
Duplicate melts into embers in the forge fire
Embers flow into the owned card; level increases with stat gains

usecase.name: Build Deck
usecase.trigger: Player opens deck builder in the Mythic Forge

mainflow.step: Player assembles 9-10 cards: base units + 1 hero + 1-2 spells + mid-tier troops
System validates deck composition rules

usecase.name: Select Faction
usecase.trigger: Player opens faction select in the Mythic Forge

mainflow.step: System presents the four factions with sigils, taglines, and color identity
Player selects a faction; forge ambience shifts to that faction's neon

usecase.postcondition: Faction locked for deck building and matchmaking
